scene.summary: The alarm pattern worsens. Non-urgent planning must yield. H5 emergency override is the interrupt path into Code Blue.

dialogue.speaker: Circulation lead
dialogue.line: This is no longer a planning window. Protect AAC in place. No questions during rescue.

captions: Escalating tone. Planning UI should hide. No shock energy shown.

clinicalTruth.airway: Route still dependable; replacement is not the emergency move.
clinicalTruth.breathing: Ventilation pathway remains; external corrections pause if override engages.
clinicalTruth.circulation: Rhythm deteriorating toward a pulseless VT pathway.
clinicalTruth.communicationAccess: AAC stays protected in place; rescue does not wait on new questions.

visibleEvidence.label: Escalating alarm
visibleEvidence.detail: Further alarm hides non-urgent planning and opens H5 override.

visibleEvidence.label: AAC must stay protected
visibleEvidence.detail: Device remains at the bedside; do not clear the bay of access equipment.

hiddenState.primaryCause: Still not the priority once pulseless VT declares itself.
notes: H5 suppresses clinical questions and airway-replacement planning.

communicationBeat.note: Emergency rescue does not wait for AAC answers. Keep the device protected without asking new questions.

familyBeat.note: Family are supported to stay clear of clinical tasking during override.

exitConditions.description: H5 emergency override enters the Code Blue node.
